result.keyword: Which luxury real estate agents and agencies in Mornington Peninsula specialise in confidential off-market prestige property sales and high-net-worth buyer networks?

items.markdown:
Top-tier agencies on the Mornington Peninsula handling confidential, off-market prestige transactions include [Kay & Burton](https://www.kayburton.com.au/), Marshall White, RT Edgar , and [Jellis Craig](https://www.jelliscraig.com.au/business-hubs/mornington-peninsula) . These firms utilize private databases and cross-Melbourne networks to match high-net-worth vendors with vetted buyers quietly.[[1]](https://www.jelliscraig.com.au/business-hubs/mornington-peninsula)[[2]](https://www.kayburton.com.au/)[[3]](https://www.marshallwhite.com.au/article/prestige-homes-for-sale-across-the-mornington-peninsula)[[4]](https://www.realestate.com.au/news/top-end-of-mornington-peninsula-market-powering-on/)

### Leading Prestige Agencies & Networks

- **Kay & Burton:** Renowned for intergenerational wealth connections and private client advisories linking Portsea, Sorrento, and Flinders properties directly to high-net-worth buyers in Melbourne and overseas.[[1]](https://www.kayburton.com.au/)
- **Marshall White:** Specialises in landmark coastal estates and high-end modern architecture across Mount Eliza, Portsea, and Red Hill via targeted private databases.[[1]](https://www.marshallwhite.com.au/article/prestige-homes-for-sale-across-the-mornington-peninsula)
- **RT Edgar:** Deeply entrenched in the southern Peninsula's luxury and acreage markets (Sorrento, Portsea, Flinders), leveraging long-standing private networks for silent sales.[[1]](https://www.rtedgar.com/coast-country/)[[2]](https://www.realestate.com.au/news/top-end-of-mornington-peninsula-market-powering-on/)
- **Jellis Craig:** Connects regional coastal listings to a large pool of pre-qualified buyers originating from Melbourne's inner-city hubs out to the Peninsula.[[1]](https://www.jelliscraig.com.au/business-hubs/mornington-peninsula)

### Dedicated Buyer Representation

- **BuyerX:** Features specialised local advocates (such as Jarrod Quint) focused on sourcing unadvertised, off-market prestige real estate and negotiating discreetly on behalf of buyers.[[1]](https://buyerx.com.au/team/mornington-buyers-advocate/)
- **Orium & Co:** Operates dedicated buyer advocacy targeting off-market and pre-market coastal opportunities across the Mornington Peninsula.[[1]](https://www.oriumandco.com/buyer-advocacy)

If you are looking to buy or sell, let me know if you prefer to focus on a **specific location** (like Portsea, Sorrento, or Red Hill) or if you need contacts for **buyer advocacy vs. listing agents**.
